'''Forsythia''' (Japanese: '''ツボミ''' ''Tsubomi'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. She operates the [[Pick a Peck of Colors Flower Shop]] in [[Floaroma Town]], where she runs [[Poffin]]-cooking classes and a [[Berry]] orchard.

==History==
[[File:Forsythia young.png|thumb|220px|left|A younger Forsythia]]
{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} saw a flyer advertising her [[Poffin]] classes and paid a visit to Forsythia's [[Pick a Peck of Colors Flower Shop|home]] in ''[[DP025|Oh Do You Know The Poffin Plan!]]''. While {{an|Dawn}} and {{an|Brock}} had no trouble making theirs, Ash struggled and ended up burning them. During the test tasting, Dawn's Poffins, despite being based on [[Johanna|her mother]]'s recipe, left a bad taste in her Pokémon's mouths. Forsythia then went on to explain that all Pokémon have different tastes just like people do. 

Ash was curious about Forsythia's {{p|Roserade}} being so [[Nature|shy]], and she told the story of how she met and befriended it by giving it her red scarf. The story was interrupted when {{TRT}} crashed through her garden in a [[Team Rocket's mechas|tank]], stealing all of her Berries. Roserade sprung into action to defend the orchard, wrapping its signature scarf around its face. Team Rocket then found out from Lotad that, without the scarf, Roserade didn't have the confidence to fight, so {{MTR}} and {{TP|James|Mime Jr.}} removed it.

They were about to run off with Roserade and the Berries, but Forsythia jumped in front of the tank and told Roserade that it didn't need the scarf to believe in itself. With that, Roserade escaped and used a beautiful {{m|Petal Dance}} attack against Team Rocket. After they were gone, Roserade's {{m|Sunny Day}} combined with Lotad's {{m|Water Gun}} made Forsythia's garden begin to regrow. Later, Dawn was finally able to make Poffins that her Pokémon liked, and thanked Forsythia for all of her help. 

Forsythia also made a brief cameo in ''[[DP150|Unlocking the Red Chain of Events!]]'' along with her Pokémon.

|desc=One day, while visiting the local [[Pokémon Center]], Forsythia encountered a {{p|Budew}} that had been injured while fighting other Pokémon. Although Budew was normally timid, Forsythia befriended it by giving it her red scarf, and [[Nurse Joy]] allowed her to adopt it. Over time, and through Forsythia's care, Budew evolved into {{p|Roselia}} and later into {{p|Roserade}}, but it never seemed to lose its shy nature. What Forsythia didn't know was that Roserade was fearlessly protecting Forsythia's Berry garden; it would gain the confidence needed to fight by wearing the red scarf it was given all those years ago.

However, when {{TRT}} attempted to steal all the Berries from the garden, they also stole the red scarf when Roserade tried to stop them, causing the Bouquet Pokémon to become timid again. However, Forsythia convinced Roserade that it was still strong. Thanks to Forsythia's kind words, Roserade's confidence returned, and Team Rocket were soon sent blasting off. Roserade later helped restore the garden with Lotad's help.

Roserade appeared again in ''[[DP150|Unlocking the Red Chain of Events!]]'' along with its Trainer and Lotad.
